Definition: adverb from G2101; quite agreeably:--acceptably, + please well.
BiblicalUsage: euaréstōs is the word for quite agreeably. It occurs just once, in Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe euaréstōs is best left as Scripture leaves it: quite agreeably.
